Anna P.: Quick check — where are we on the H100 procurement queue? A bunch of customers are asking for Dedicated capacity timelines. Who's tracking POs and ship ETA? (cc @Linda R., @Mike C.)

Mike C.: Procurement update: PO# 77821 & PO# 77822 submitted last week. Carrier ETA for first pallet shows 2026-06-05. Vendor says manufacturing complete, awaiting customs paperwork. Linda, can you confirm clearance SLA?

Linda R.: On it. Escalated with vendor rep this morning. If docs come in today we expect clear by 2026-06-01; otherwise fallback window is 2026-06-10. I'll update the procurement tracker and flag any changes.

Sanjay K.: For infra work, rack power upgrades are scheduled 2026-05-20 -> 2026-05-24 in dc-chi. Need final lift specs from hw-team (U-space + top-of-rack clearance). @Taylor M. is this still your ownership?

Taylor M.: Yes, we're owners on the lift. Will post lift plan + cable routing EOD tomorrow. Also flag: we need vendor NIC firmware image (ticket INF-3421) and RDMA driver whitelist before canary.

Anna P.: Ownership check: who owns cluster readiness sign-off (OS image, NVSwitch firmware, QA canaries)?

Mike C.: Sign-off owners: infra for rack/power (Taylor M.), runtime for image + perf validation (Sanjay K.), eng-ml for correctness canaries (Priya R.). I'll spin up a rollout checklist and assign concrete owners + SLAs.

Taylor M.: FYI — canaries will need the internal model-runner image. @Priya R., do you have the canary prompts and expected pass/fail criteria ready?

Priya R.: Working on a 3-prompt smoke suite (latency + token correctness + memory spot-check). Will share by EOD tomorrow. Target baseline: p50 < 70ms on the base prompt and no token regressions on the smoke set.

Linda R.: Procurement note: if customs delays push beyond 2026-06-10 we should consider converting one order to airfreight — cost +3x but saves 7–10 days. Need finance approval before we pull the trigger.

Anna P.: Finance approval pinged. @Jorge F. from finance, could you weigh in on airfreight tradeoff once we have the incremental cost?

Jorge F.: If customer SLA risk > 72 hours, approve airfreight for critical racks. Send SKU list + incremental cost estimate and I'll expedite approval.

Mike C.: I'll attach SKU list to the rollout checklist. Also a question on reservation mapping: when the racks land, what's our process to map physical racks to existing Dedicated reservations? Auto-assign to pending queue or hold for manual assignment?

Sanjay K.: Proposal: hold for 48h after FQDN + HW smoke tests, then auto-allocate following FIFO queue. Ops can override as needed. That gives time to run the canaries and catch flaky hardware.

Anna P.: Sounds reasonable. @Mike C. can you add that to the checklist? Also code-review ping: PR #4826 (reservation-allocator) is blocked on infra test runs. @Taylor M., can you run the integration test on the staging rack once the first pallet is in the lab?

Taylor M.: Will run integration tests. If shipments clear as-is, ETA for integration run is 2026-06-07; if we need to airfreight, ETA shifts to 2026-06-15 after the emergency dock.

inventory-bot: PO 77821 status changed -> "in-transit". Dock ETA updated to 2026-06-03 (subject to customs).

Anna P.: Thanks. Final ask: if we hit customs delay, who's owning customer comms? @Megan L. in CS to prep a templated note?

Megan L.: I can prepare the template and hold until we have confirmed dock ETA. Will share draft by EOD and tag legal for any wording constraints.

Mike C.: I'll triage blockers and update the rollout checklist daily. Posting checklist link: https://redwood.tools/internal/rollouts/77821 (internal).

Anna P.: :thumbsup: Let's keep async updates in this thread. If anything changes dramatically, we'll call a quick sync.
